_meta.title: Build a Golfer — roster (expanded)
_meta.methodology: Established current players anchored to real 2026 PGA Tour stats (distance, accuracy, sand-save, putting, scoring) from ESPN; approach/short-game/scrambling/composure are expert estimates pending DataGolf Strokes-Gained normalization. Legends are reputation/career-based (no SG pre-2004). Rising players are projections off limited pro data and should be treated as the softest estimates.
_meta.rarity_note: Spin draws a BUCKET by these fixed rates, then a uniform-random golfer within that bucket (excluding any already revealed this draft). Bucket rates are independent of how many golfers a bucket holds.
_meta.archetypes: Each golfer has a signature spike skill (their 'archetype'), a secondary strength, and at least one genuine weakness; full 0-99 spread by design.
_meta.fields_note: 'nation' is the short code (good for flags/compact display); 'country' is the full home-country name.

rating_scale.basis: Active players anchored to current PGA Tour Strokes Gained (per round) + traditional stats, normalized to 0-99 where ~80 = tour average.
rating_scale.sg_category_to_rating: leader/elite ~95-97 | top10 ~90-93 | top25 ~86-89 | top50 ~82-85 | tour avg ~80 | below avg ~75-79 | poor ~68-74
rating_scale.composure: no clean stat — derived from closing record, final-round play, and major/clutch performance
rating_scale.legends: reputation/career-based; no Strokes Gained data exists pre-2004

_meta.data_source_note: dist/acc/app/sht/scr/bnk/put for matched players = DataGolf Strokes Gained skill ratings (2026-06-22) normalized to 0-99 (tour avg=80, elite~96). Composure (clu) and all unmatched/legend players remain manual/reputation. scr=arg+putt blend; bnk derived from arg (no separate sand-save stat in this feed). | Legends tagged 'historical peak' use their best DataGolf-era season for SG skills (app/sht/put, and scr/bnk derived); distance, accuracy, composure remain reputation (historical driving data is sparse, composure has no stat). Pre-2004 peakers kept as reputation.
_meta.career_note: Career mode = single bounded run, ages forward within the run, full reset on retirement. potential is the EXPECTED ceiling (display/arcade); pot_band {lo,hi,exp,boom,bust} is rolled fresh per career from the career_seed so trajectories vary each universe (talent tilts odds, dice stay live). Established players have tight bands; teens swing wide. See runthetour-career-spec.md.
